thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize which evals and artifacts go into the Optimize Toolkit v1. Customers keep asking for batching/caching recommendations + curated prompt sets. I sketched a small decision rubric below. Can folks weigh in by EOD?

aj: +1. One clarification: does Sales expect a regression gate before GA for customer-driven asks? They pushed for 'no regressions = no GA' on a few deals.

sam: i'm leaning toward requiring regressions for high-impact customers. for v1 we can limit scope: 3 prompt sets (query-rewrite, convo-fallback, and summarization) and a docs-first rollout for batching recs.

olivia: uploaded a draft prompt-set index: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/optimize-eval-drafts. The main tradeoff is deliverability — docs-only vs infra changes. Docs-only gets value to customers fast.

kevin: from eng: adding telemetry + auto-suggestion hooks for batching is non-trivial. rough estimate: 2w for telemetry + 1w for basic UI + 1w for infra rollout testing. If we want a regression suite integrated, add another week.

maria: proposal to break into milestones:
M1 — Docs + curated prompt sets + baseline recommendations (no regression gate)
M2 — Telemetry-backed batching suggestions + regression suite + customer pilot (regression gate)
This lets us ship customer-facing guidance quickly while gating infra-heavy items.

aj: sounds pragmatic. can we add a customer-impact scoring column? helps prioritize which asks go into M1 vs M2.

maria: added a tiny prioritization matrix: 
```
Priority | Customer impact | Effort (weeks) | Gate
P0       | >$10k/mo        | 4w             | regression
P1       | $1k-10k/mo      | 2w             | monitoring
P2       | < $1k/mo        | 1w             | docs-only
```

sam: note for prompt sets: we should include canonical input, instruction, expected output, and tolerance thresholds. example format: `input`, `instruction`, `gold`, `metrics` (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim).

olivia: i'll own the prompt sets and will open a PR with 3 initial sets by Wed. kevin — can you confirm eng estimates?

kevin: confirm estimate. if olivia starts with docs and sample JSONs we can parallelize the telemetry work. regression run on sample customers needs an additional week to execute.

maria: final ask for this thread:
- aj: prioritize customer asks and label P0/P1/P2
- olivia: create prompt-set PR + canonical examples
- kevin: schedule infra spike and confirm timeline in ticket
I'll update the roadmap and the OKR card after you all ack.

aj: will do, pinging @customer-success for final customer list. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: Regression job queued: `job/optimize-evals-176512` scheduled 2025-11-05T16:00:00Z

kevin: one more thing — we should include a lightweight A/B plan to measure token savings vs quality. I'll add a draft to the ticket.

maria: perfect, thanks everyone — closing the thread unless anything else pops up.
